baseline: strict-weight-verified public A3, unchanged 20m radius/784 cells
splits: full original Train Seen, pre-existing held-out Internal Dev maps; no Seen/Unseen/closed-loop
target_candidates: all map objects, never GT-dependent TopK filtering
unknown: preserve omitted support mass; no observation means exactly zero RGB evidence
geometry: polygon boundary distance; symmetric polygon-hull Between with anchor interiors excluded; 15m corridor scale; nested factors retained
inference: sum-product target marginal over reference assignments; separate hard-MAP control
goal: public position kernel sigma10m plus continuous spatial field; A3 fallback for Unknown
roi_quality: side>=10px, depth support>=0.9; geometric proxy, no human semantic truth
training: full Train geometry calibration, 3 epochs; matched geometry-only and RGB parameter budget; RGB available only for cached Train families; all backbones frozen
optimizer: AdamW lr0.001, effective batch32; no Seen selection
stopping: at most 3 epochs per small head, at most 15min preprocessing per stage; retain negative results; no GAT/RL/navigation training
